# STAT 4052 Final Project - Spring 2026
# Predicting Maximum Heart Rate | Doua Vue


## Data 
```{r}
library(glmnet)
library(randomForest)
library(caret)
library(MASS)
 
set.seed(123)

data <- read.csv("STAT4052/processed.cleveland.data",
                 header = FALSE, na.strings = "?",
                 col.names = c("age", "sex", "cp", "trestbps", "chol", "fbs",
                               "restecg", "thalach", "exang", "oldpeak", "slope",
                               "ca", "thal", "target"))
data <- na.omit(data)
 
bc <- boxcox(thalach ~ age + sex + cp + trestbps + chol + fbs + restecg + exang + 
               oldpeak + slope + ca + thal, data = data)
bc$x[which.max(bc$y)]  

```

## Train Test Split 
```{r}
# ── TRAIN/TEST SPLIT ──────────────────────────────────────────
idx    <- createDataPartition(data$thalach, p = 0.80, list = FALSE)
train  <- data[idx, ]
test   <- data[-idx, ]
 
f <- thalach ~ age+sex+cp+trestbps+chol+fbs+restecg+exang+oldpeak+slope+ca+thal
 
X_train <- model.matrix(f, train)[, -1]
X_test  <- model.matrix(f, test)[, -1]
y_train <- train$thalach
y_test  <- test$thalach

```

## Calcuations 
```{r}
# ── METRICS HELPER ────────────────────────────────────────────
metrics <- function(actual, pred) {
  e <- actual - pred
  c(MSE  = mean(e^2),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean(e^2)),
    MAE  = mean(abs(e)),
    R2   = 1 - sum(e^2) / sum((actual - mean(actual))^2))
}

```

## Multiple Linear Regression 
```{r}
# ── 1. MULTIPLE LINEAR REGRESSION ────────────────────────────
mlr  <- lm(f, data = train)
summary(mlr)
par(mfrow = c(2,2)); plot(mlr); par(mfrow = c(1,1))
mlr_m <- metrics(y_test, predict(mlr, test))

```

## Ridge 
```{r}
# ── 2. RIDGE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
ridge_cv <- cv.glmnet(X_train, y_train, alpha = 0, nfolds = 10)
plot(ridge_cv)
ridge_m  <- metrics(y_test, as.vector(predict(ridge_cv, X_test, s = "lambda.min")))

```

## Lasso 
```{r}
# ── 3. LASSO ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
lasso_cv <- cv.glmnet(X_train, y_train, alpha = 1, nfolds = 10)
plot(lasso_cv)
coef(lasso_cv, s = "lambda.min")   # non-zero = selected variables
lasso_m  <- metrics(y_test, as.vector(predict(lasso_cv, X_test, s = "lambda.min")))

```

## Random Forest 
```{r}
# ── 4. RANDOM FOREST ──────────────────────────────────────────
rf   <- randomForest(f, data = train, ntree = 500, importance = TRUE)
varImpPlot(rf, type = 1, main = "Variable Importance (%IncMSE)")
rf_m <- metrics(y_test, predict(rf, test))

```

#Comparison 
```{r}
# ── COMPARISON TABLE ──────────────────────────────────────────
results <- rbind(MLR = mlr_m, Ridge = ridge_m, Lasso = lasso_m, RF = rf_m)
round(results, 3)

```

## Predicted vs Actual 
```{r}
# ── PREDICTED VS ACTUAL (best model) ─────────────────────────
plot(y_test, predict(rf, test), pch = 16, col = "steelblue",
     xlab = "Actual", ylab = "Predicted", main = "RF: Predicted vs Actual")
abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2)

```
